wat321.enableClaude.markdownDescription: Enable Claude widgets (usage bars and session tokens). Hidden automatically if the Claude CLI is not installed.

wat321.enableCodex.markdownDescription: Enable Codex widgets (usage bars and session tokens). Hidden automatically if the Codex CLI is not installed.

wat321.modelBridge.enabled.markdownDescription:
Adds Big Pickle, GPT 5 Nano, Ling 2.6 Flash, Hy3 Preview, Nemotron 3 Super, and MiniMax M2.5 to Claude as routable models. When on, WAT321 auto-spawns a managed `opencode serve` on `127.0.0.1:4096` so the tool-using harness (`model_bridge_task`) works against any catalog instance, including your local LLM. Direct chat completions (`model_bridge_ask`, `model_bridge_thread`) keep working whether this is on or off. Hidden automatically when the OpenCode CLI is not installed (`npm i -g opencode-ai`).

**Enable OpenCode**

enumDescriptions: Receive system notifications when your editor is unfocused, in-app when focused
Only use Windows, Linux and macOS notifications
wat321.notifications.mode.markdownDescription: Notify you when Claude or Codex finishes a response.

wat321.notifications.claude.markdownDescription: Show notifications for Claude sessions. Requires Claude to be enabled.

wat321.notifications.codex.markdownDescription: Show notifications for Codex sessions. Requires Codex to be enabled.

enumDescriptions: Automatic - Full when only one provider is active, Compact when both are active
Full usage widgets with compact session tokens
Compact progress bars (5 blocks), slim session tokens
Text-only status bar, progress bars move to tooltips on hover
wat321.displayMode.markdownDescription: Status bar display density. Auto adjusts based on how many providers are active. **Full + Compact** keeps usage widgets at full size while shrinking session-token labels - useful when the status bar is full and you want to free space without losing usage detail.

wat321.statusBarPriority.markdownDescription: Base priority for WAT321 status bar items. Higher values appear further left. Adjust if widgets overlap with other extensions. *Requires window reload.*

wat321.enableHeatmap.markdownDescription: Enable heatmap colors on the usage progress bar. The bars gradually shift through warning colors as you get closer to your limits so tight sessions stand out at a glance.

wat321.epicHandshake.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Enable Epic Handshake - Experimental** - Lets you say things like *"Ask Codex to review this"* in any Claude session and have Codex actually answer, through a small bridge WAT321 runs locally. Both the Claude and Codex widgets must be on for this to work.

After you turn this on, any active Claude sessions will need to be restarted so they can use the bridge. New sessions pick it up automatically. Same applies in reverse: turning this off fully removes the bridge for new Claude sessions, but already active Claude sessions keep a tiny cached reference to the bridge (roughly 20 tokens per prompt) until you restart the session. *Note: resuming an existing Claude session recalculates the entire balance on first load. In other words, just leave it off until you are done with the session - it unloads automatically when the session ends.*

Bridge can be paused by clicking on the Epic Handshake status bar and selecting **Pause** from the top of the dropdown.

wat321.epicHandshake.suppressCodexNotifi.markdownDescription: Suppress Codex completion notifications while the Epic Handshake bridge is active. You still get the Claude notification when Claude finishes integrating the reply, so there's no silent delivery - this just avoids two back-to-back notifications for the same exchange. Turn this off if you want Codex notifications regardless.

enumDescriptions: Register every available bridge target. Maximum routing flexibility, largest MCP tool surface (~all targets in the wat321_ask schema).
Codex and OpenCode/Big Pickle. Common case for users running both Anthropic and Zhipu/SST.
Codex via Epic Handshake only. Smallest MCP surface; useful when OpenCode is not configured.
OpenCode/Big Pickle / Local LLM via opencode serve only. Skip Codex registration entirely.
Local LLM only. Offline / cost-conscious / experimental. Requires modelBridge.localEndpoint.
wat321.epicHandshake.bridgeMode.markdownDescription: Which bridges Epic Handshake exposes to Claude. Narrowing this saves Claude system-prompt tokens by registering only the targets you actually use. Requires window reload after change - MCP tool registrations are snapshotted at connection time. Has no effect when Epic Handshake is off.

wat321.modelBridge.localEndpoint.markdownDescription:
Base URL for your local LLM server. Examples: `http://127.0.0.1:8080` for a llama.cpp `--jinja` server on the dev box, `http://10.0.0.91:8080` for a separate LLM box on the LAN, `http://localhost:11434` for Ollama. The bridge appends `/v1/chat/completions` per call.

**Empty (default):** Local LLM is hidden from the catalog and not registered as a routable target - WAT321 does not assume you have a local server running. Only OpenCode/Zen routes are available.

**Filled:** Local LLM appears as a catalog instance; the unified bridge routes `target=local` calls there when Model Bridge is enabled.

wat321.clearAllData.markdownDescription: **Reset WAT321** - Restore WAT321 to its defaults and clear everything it has stored locally. If any WAT321 tool appears unresponsive, this will reset all to a known-good state. A confirmation dialog will appear before resetting.
